"""
SamplerV2
---------

*A primitive that samples the output of quantum circuits.*

Designed for the Qiskit Runtime service, SamplerV2 lets you obtain
quasi-probability dictionaries from one or more parametrized or
non-parametrized quantum circuits.

Key differences from SamplerV1
-----------------------------
SamplerV2 (Qiskit Runtime)          |  SamplerV1 (legacy)
------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------
Session-less: every call is atomic  |  Required a persistent session
Pubs interface: (circ, params, ...) |  Flat list interface
Always returns `SamplerPubResult`  |  Returned a list of quasi-dists
Supports error suppression/mit.     |  Basic error handling only
Part of Runtime V2 stack (`qiskit-ibm-runtime` ≥ 0.21)

Minimal (pseudo-code) usage
-------------------------
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService, SamplerV2  # install first

qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
qc.h(0)
qc.cx(0,1)
qc.measure_all()

service = QiskitRuntimeService(channel="ibm_quantum")
backend = service.least_busy(operational=True, simulator=False)

sampler = SamplerV2(backend)          # no session.start() needed
job = sampler.run([(qc,)], shots=1024)  # pub tuple
result = job.result()[0]                # SamplerPubResult
quasi_probs = result.data.meas          # dict of bitstr → probability
"""
